axis.note: one dated axis; the collapse cut is 2022-12-11 and the first collapsed acquisition (2022-12-23) is drawn hollow at the right edge

dims.note: all six dimensions are drawn on both stretches; gamma2 and A are the same two backend columns on either side, while P/D/F/S are recomputed from a committed full-dwell strip cache with the pipeline's own mask rule — the channel table's strip set for the record, the era's own 162-strip set (data/kdlo/strips_era/) for the era

era_strips.p_basis: the frequency map of these 162 era strips (never mixed with the record's strip set; the set carries both polarisations, 83 VH and 79 VV days, which is what its frequency map is counted over)

normalisation.no_pooling: the era (ASCENDING, IW2, relative orbit 136, catalogue hour 00) and the record (DESCENDING, IW1, relative orbit 12) are two geometries read off the availability reference; no number of this figure is computed over both, and the 69-day blind gap is never bridged
normalisation.p_basis: P is a mask frequency, so it is only defined against the strip set it is counted over: the era's P over its own 162 strips, the record's over the strip set the channel table recomputes from. The two frequency maps are never added, averaged or used to rescale one another — each stretch is drawn as its own value/median, and one basis is constant inside one stretch. Within the era's basis the strips are not one polarisation (the track carries both VV and VH), so its frequency map is a mixed-set frequency; each era day's own four values come from that day's own burst alone
normalisation.record: median of the 16 record days inside the axis (2022-06-02..2022-12-11)
normalisation.rule: each stretch divided by its own median

role: companion — the A-E record (60 descending acquisitions, 2022-06-02..2023-05-…, released 2025-11-24) drawn inside the seven and a half years of catalogue coverage that precede it

segments.label: the ascending IW2 era

The track is measured on both VV and VH bursts, so the set carries both polarisations; each day is one burst, and only P's frequency map is counted across the mixed set
segments.p_basis: the 162 era strips of this figure (data/kdlo/strips_era/), both polarisations in the set
